description: Web UI for mohist - embedded React SPA with kanban view, issue detail, SSE real-time events via in-process EventBus, and issue management operations with Stop & Resume approval gates

tasks.title: Initialize React SPA project with Vite
tasks.description: Create packages/cli/web/ directory with Vite + React + TypeScript setup. Configure Vite with React plugin, Tailwind CSS, and API proxy to backend. Add build:web and dev:web scripts to package.json.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build:web produces dist/ with index.html and JS/CSS bundles
npm run dev:web starts Vite dev server on port 5173 with /api/* proxy
Tailwind CSS is configured and applies base styles
React renders a placeholder page at /

tasks.title: Implement EventBus module
tasks.description: Create a simple in-process EventBus class with emit/on/off methods. Create singleton instance. This will be injected into Agent tools (advance_stage, add_comment) and consumed by SSE endpoint.
acceptanceCriteria: EventBus class supports emit(event, data) and on(event, listener)
EventBus singleton is exportable for shared use
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep it simple - a Map<string, Set<listener>> is sufficient. No external deps needed.

tasks.title: Extract AgentRunnerService from issues.ts
tasks.description: Extract agent running logic from issues.ts module-level variables (activeAgentIssueId, activeAgentPromise) into a proper AgentRunnerService class. Service provides start(), getStatus(), isRunning() methods. Inject EventBus to emit agent_started/agent_completed/agent_error events. Wire AgentRunnerService into server startup and API routes.
acceptanceCriteria: AgentRunnerService class encapsulates agent state tracking
start() method runs runMainAgent with lifecycle event emission
getStatus() returns { running, issueId, issueNumber }
isRunning() returns boolean
agent_started/agent_completed/agent_error events emitted via EventBus
issues.ts POST /:number/start uses AgentRunnerService instead of module-level vars
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This is prerequisite for GET /api/agent/status and SSE agent lifecycle events. Extract the pattern from issues.ts lines 9-10, 321-345.

tasks.title: Inject EventBus into Agent tools
tasks.description: Inject EventBus into advance_stage and add_comment tools. advance_stage emits stage_changed after successful DB write. add_comment emits comment_added after successful DB write. When advance_stage detects approval gate (next stage has approval:true), emit approval_requested event.
acceptanceCriteria: advance_stage tool emits stage_changed after issueRepo.updateStage()
add_comment tool emits comment_added after commentRepo.create()
advance_stage tool emits approval_requested when target stage has approval:true
EventBus is injected via tool context (not imported as singleton)
Existing tool behavior unchanged when EventBus is not provided
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Add optional eventBus field to AdvanceStageContext and AddCommentContext. Emit after successful DB write only.

tasks.title: Implement SSE endpoint
tasks.description: Add GET /api/events SSE endpoint using Hono streamSSE. Support optional projectId query parameter for project-scoped filtering. Subscribe to EventBus and forward events to connected clients. Support all event types: stage_changed, comment_added, agent_started, agent_completed, agent_error, approval_requested.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/events returns SSE stream with Content-Type text/event-stream
GET /api/events?projectId=xxx filters events to specified project
stage_changed events include projectId for filtering
All 6 event types are forwarded to SSE clients
Connection cleanup on client disconnect (remove EventBus listener)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use Hono's streamSSE helper. Each SSE connection subscribes to EventBus with its own listener, unsubscribes on close.

tasks.title: Add new API endpoints for Web UI
tasks.description: Add POST /api/issues/:number/approve, GET /api/issues/:number/diff, GET /api/agent/status endpoints. Approve endpoint: validates issue is at approval gate (next stage has approval:true), resumes by spawning new agent session with context from comments. Diff endpoint: uses WorktreeManager to get git diff for issue's worktree branch. Agent status: delegates to AgentRunnerService.getStatus().
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/issues/:number/approve starts new agent session for gate issues
POST /api/issues/:number/approve returns 400 for non-gate issues
POST /api/issues/:number/approve returns 400 if agent already running
Approve extracts plan output from latest agent comment for context
GET /api/agent/status returns { running, issueId, issueNumber }
GET /api/issues/:number/diff returns changed files list using WorktreeManager
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Approve logic: (1) load issue, (2) validate stage has approval gate, (3) load latest comment as context, (4) create new MainAgent session with context, (5) AgentRunnerService.start(). Diff needs WorktreeManager.list() or similar.

tasks.title: Embed static files in Hono server
tasks.description: Configure Hono to serve static files from the Vite build output. Add SPA fallback (serve index.html for non-API routes). Ensure API routes take priority over static files.
acceptanceCriteria: Server serves index.html at /
Server serves JS/CSS assets from /assets/*
Non-API, non-static paths return index.html (SPA fallback)
API routes (/api/*) are not intercepted by static serving
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Implement frontend API client and TanStack Query setup
tasks.description: Create API client module for all REST endpoints. Set up TanStack Query with QueryClientProvider. Create hooks for fetching projects, issues, comments, labels, and agent status.
acceptanceCriteria: API client module exports typed functions for all endpoints
TanStack Query QueryClientProvider wraps the app
useIssues() hook fetches issues filtered by current project
useAgentStatus() hook fetches agent status
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use fetch API directly, no axios needed

tasks.title: Implement kanban board page
tasks.description: Build the main kanban view with 5 stage columns (draft, plan, build, check, done). Each issue displays as a card with number, title, labels, and status. Show agent running indicator and approval gate badge on relevant cards.
acceptanceCriteria: Kanban displays 5 columns with correct stage names
Issue cards show number, title, labels
Cards in paused/blocked status show visual indicator
Agent running indicator appears when agent is active on an issue
Approval gate badge appears for issues waiting at gate
Empty columns show empty state
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use CSS grid or flexbox for columns. Cards should be clickable to navigate to detail.

tasks.title: Implement project selector in header
tasks.description: Add header component with mohist logo, project selector dropdown, and new issue button. Project selector fetches projects list and allows switching. All data refreshes when project changes. SSE connection reconnects with new projectId on project switch.
acceptanceCriteria: Header displays project selector with current project
Dropdown lists all available projects
Selecting a project refreshes kanban data
Single project shows name without dropdown
SSE connection reconnects with new projectId on switch
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Store current project in React state, pass to all query hooks and SSE connection

tasks.title: Implement issue detail page
tasks.description: Build issue detail page with stage progress bar, description, comments list, approval gate action area, and git diff summary. Use React Router for /issue/:number route.
acceptanceCriteria: Detail page displays all issue fields
Stage progress bar shows current position in workflow
Comments listed chronologically with timestamps
Approval action area shows when gate is active with Approve & Skip buttons
Git diff section shows changed files for build/check/done stages
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use React Router useParams() for issue number. Detect approval gate by checking if current stage has approval:true in workflow config.

tasks.title: Implement issue action dialogs
tasks.description: Add create issue dialog, edit issue dialog, close/reopen buttons, start issue button, and add comment form. Wire all actions to API endpoints and invalidate TanStack Query cache on success.
acceptanceCriteria: Create issue dialog creates issue and refreshes kanban
Edit issue dialog updates title/body/labels
Close button sets status to blocked
Reopen button sets status to active
Start button triggers agent for draft issues
Start button disabled when agent already running
Add comment form appends comment to list
All actions show loading/error states
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use shadcn/ui Dialog, Button, Input, Textarea components

tasks.title: Implement SSE client and real-time updates
tasks.description: Create SSE client hook that connects to /api/events?projectId=xxx and dispatches events. Integrate with TanStack Query to invalidate relevant queries on events (stage_changed → invalidate issues, comment_added → invalidate comments). Handle reconnection on disconnect.
acceptanceCriteria: SSE hook connects to /api/events?projectId=xxx and receives events
stage_changed event triggers issues query refetch
comment_added event triggers comments query refetch
agent_started/completed/error events trigger agent status refetch
approval_requested event triggers issues refetch
Automatic reconnection after disconnect
SSE reconnects with new projectId on project switch
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use EventSource API with reconnection logic. Close old connection and create new one on project switch.
